summary:
[reference generation] Create a 10-second cinematic lifestyle montage featuring <Subject 1> across a leafy street, a café, and a sunlit park. Follow a gentle progression of looking back, resting her cheek on her hand, brushing away loose hair, walking across grass, reaching toward sunlight, and relaxing on a bench at sunset.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in all six shots): fully_preserved - maintain the identity and complete wardrobe established by <Picture 1> across locations, expressions, and camera distances. Allow natural changes in pose and lighting.

detailed_description:
A photorealistic lifestyle film, 10 seconds, 16:9 landscape framing. Soft warm colors, delicate film grain, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, and gentle handheld camera movement. Compose each scene across the full horizontal frame, allowing the surroundings to breathe. Use clean cuts and relaxed gestures rather than abrupt performance changes.

[Shot 1] From 0 to 1.8 seconds, follow <Subject 1> from behind along a quiet tree-lined city sidewalk. Dappled sunlight moves across the paving, with storefronts and a pedestrian-crossing sign visible farther along the street. While continuing to walk, she turns her head and upper body back toward the camera. Her expression opens into a small, warm smile. Track smoothly beside and behind her, keeping the turn natural and the street visible on both sides.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.800, cut to a medium portrait at a small round café table. <Subject 1> rests one elbow on the tabletop and supports her cheek lightly with her palm. Her other forearm lies comfortably along the table edge. A clear takeaway drink with a straw sits nearby. She looks directly toward the camera with a quiet, attentive expression and a faint smile. Warm café shelves and glass doors remain softly blurred behind her.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.200, cut to a close three-quarter side profile outdoors. A light breeze moves a few loose strands across her forehead and cheek. She raises one hand, gently brushes the strands away from her face, and lowers the hand. Her eyes remain directed slightly beyond the lens as her lips soften into a small smile. Keep the camera intimate and nearly stationary.

[Shot 4] At 00:04.800, cut to a medium-wide view of <Subject 1> walking slowly across an open green lawn. Track laterally at her pace, with distant trees forming a soft background. She glances downward, then turns toward the camera with a brighter smile and a brief playful wink. Let her arms swing naturally as she continues walking.

[Shot 5] At 00:06.300, cut to an upper-body view beneath a leafy tree. Low sunlight shines through gaps in the canopy. <Subject 1> tilts her chin upward and slowly lifts one hand toward the illuminated leaves, fingers relaxed and slightly separated. Her gaze follows the hand. Let the sun briefly glimmer between her fingers as the camera drifts gently sideways, revealing changing layers of foliage.

[Shot 6] At 00:08.000, cut to a side medium view of <Subject 1> sitting comfortably on a wooden park bench. Her hands rest beside her on the seat, and her shoulders remain relaxed. The setting sun glows behind the distant tree line, giving the scene a soft golden rim light.

She lifts her face slightly toward the light with a peaceful, understated smile. Move gradually closer from the side into a three-quarter facial close-up. Keep her gaze directed just above and beyond the camera rather than forcing a direct look. End at 10 seconds on the quiet smile, with warm sunlight and the lawn softly blurred behind her.
